public_domain_references.web: He alone has immortality, dwelling in unapproachable light, whom no man has seen nor can see, to whom be honor and eternal power. Amen.

public_domain_references.kjv: Who only hath immortality, dwelling in the light which no man can approach unto; whom no man hath seen, nor can see: to whom [be] honour and power everlasting. Amen.

pob.text: Command those who are rich in the present age not to be arrogant[a], nor to set their hope on the uncertainty of riches, but on God[b], who richly provides us with everything for enjoyment.

spob.text: Command those who are rich in this present age not to be proud or to put their hope in wealth, because wealth is uncertain. Instead, they must put their hope in God, who richly provides us with everything to enjoy.

public_domain_references.bsb: Instruct those who are rich in the present age not to be conceited and not to put their hope in the uncertainty of wealth, but in God, who richly provides all things for us to enjoy.

pob.text: O Timothy[a], guard the deposit entrusted to you[b], turning away from the profane empty talk and contradictions of what is falsely called knowledge.
